additional_info.body:
Dear Malek,
I hope you are doing well.
As we reviewed the logs from the past few days, we observed that the session was initiated and entered charging mode as expected. However, we also noted that the battery had already reached 100% State of Charge (SOC), which explains why the session showed as suspended.
We hope this clarifies the situation.
Could you please confirm if we can proceed to close the case?
Alternatively, for testing purposes, please use an EV with an SOC of less than 100%.
Looking forward to your update.
